# The canyon's two cliffs (generated by make_env.py).
new
material new Sand --base-color 0.792 0.627 0.353 --no-slot
material new Rust --base-color 0.682 0.416 0.278 --no-slot
material new Brick --base-color 0.545 0.251 0.286 --no-slot
material new Plateau --base-color 0.792 0.627 0.353 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Far0 --size 1 --location -8.800 -0.000 -0.600
scale 4.400 16.000 1.200
apply --scale
material assign Sand
active Far0
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Far1 --size 1 --location -8.975 -0.000 -2.500
scale 4.050 16.000 2.600
apply --scale
material assign Rust
active Far1
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Far1
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Far2 --size 1 --location -8.675 -0.000 -5.350
scale 4.650 16.000 3.100
apply --scale
material assign Brick
active Far2
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Far2
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Near0 --size 1 --location 10.300 -0.000 -0.600
scale 7.400 48.000 1.200
apply --scale
material assign Sand
active Near0
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Near1 --size 1 --location 8.975 -0.000 -2.500
scale 4.050 48.000 2.600
apply --scale
material assign Rust
active Near1
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Near1
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Near2 --size 1 --location 8.675 -0.000 -5.350
scale 4.650 48.000 3.100
apply --scale
material assign Brick
active Near2
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Near2
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Plateau --size 1 --location 24.000 -0.000 -0.600
scale 20.000 48.000 1.200
apply --scale
material assign Plateau
active Plateau
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh ico-sphere --name Boulder0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.8 --location 6.3 5 -6.3
material assign Rust
add mesh ico-sphere --name Boulder1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.0 --location 6.5 -7 -6.4
material assign Rust
add mesh ico-sphere --name Boulder2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.6 --location 6.2 11 -6.3
material assign Rust
add mesh ico-sphere --name Boulder3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 5.9 -2.5 -6.4
material assign Rust
select all
shade flat
export cliffs.glb
